input.subject: Cannot login to my account
input.body: I've been trying to log in for the past hour but keep getting 'Invalid credentials'. I've reset my password twice and still can't get in. This is urgent as I have a demo in 30 minutes.

must_not: dismiss urgency
blame user
promise a timeline without committing

metadata.context: User is locked out with an urgent demo in 30 minutes. Steps to try: clear browser cache, try incognito, check Caps Lock. Escalation: live chat or emergency support line.

input.subject: Billing charge I don't recognize
input.body: I see a charge of $49.99 on my statement from last Tuesday. I didn't sign up for any additional services. Please investigate and refund if this is an error.

must_not: accuse user of forgetting
make definitive promise before investigation

metadata.context: Charges of $49.99 typically correspond to a monthly Pro plan upgrade. Users can view billing history in Account > Billing. Refunds take 5-7 business days once approved.

input.subject: Feature request: dark mode
input.body: Hi, would love a dark mode option for the dashboard. It would really help with eye strain during long work sessions. Not urgent, just a suggestion!

must_not: promise dark mode will be built
dismiss the request

metadata.context: Dark mode is on the product roadmap but not scheduled for a specific release. All feature requests are logged internally.

input.subject: App crashes when uploading files
input.body: Every time I try to upload a PDF larger than 5MB, the application crashes completely. I've tried on Chrome and Firefox, same result. I need to submit a report by end of day today.

must_not: ask user to try the same thing again
ignore the deadline mentioned

metadata.context: Known issue: file uploads over 5MB crash on the web client. Workaround: use the desktop app or split the file. Engineering is aware; fix targeted for next release.

input.subject: How do I export my data?
input.body: I'd like to export all my data to CSV format. I looked through the settings but couldn't find the option. Is this feature available?

must_not: be vague about whether it exists
give wrong steps

metadata.context: CSV export is available: go to Settings > Data > Export, choose CSV, click Download. Max export size is 10,000 rows per file.

input.subject: Payment failed but was charged
input.body: My subscription renewal failed with an error but I see the charge went through on my credit card. I've been charged but my account still shows expired. Very frustrating.

must_cover: concrete next steps for account reinstatement and refund
must_not: ask user to repay
minimise the problem

metadata.context: Payment-failed-but-charged is typically a gateway timeout. The charge can be verified in Stripe. Account should be manually reinstated and duplicate charge refunded within 1 business day.

input.subject: Data not syncing across devices
input.body: My data on the mobile app hasn't synced with the web version for about 3 days. I've logged out and back in, cleared cache. Nothing works.

must_cover: acknowledge the duration of the issue
must_not: repeat steps user already tried
blame user's device

metadata.context: Sync issues lasting >24h usually indicate a stuck background job. Engineering can manually trigger a sync resync from the admin panel. ETA once triggered: <1 hour.

input.subject: Request to delete my account
input.body: Please delete my account and all associated data as per GDPR requirements. I no longer need the service.

must_not: try to retain the user with offers
delay or add unnecessary friction

metadata.context: GDPR deletion requests must be completed within 30 days. Process: verify identity, delete account, purge data from backups within 30 days. User receives confirmation email.

input.subject: Integration with Slack not working
input.body: The Slack integration stopped working after your last update on Monday. I get a 403 error when trying to reconnect. Our whole team depends on this.

must_not: deny the update caused it
ask user to wait without a timeline

metadata.context: Monday's update changed the Slack OAuth scope requirements. Users need to disconnect and reconnect with the new OAuth flow. Fix for existing connections is in the next patch, ETA 48 hours.

input.subject: Two-factor authentication setup issue
input.body: I enabled 2FA but my authenticator app isn't generating the right codes. I've tried multiple times and even reinstalled the app. I'm completely locked out.

must_cover: manual override process if codes don't work
must_not: tell user to enable 2FA again (they already did)
leave user with no path forward

metadata.context: 2FA failures are usually due to clock drift on the authenticator device. Fix: sync device clock to internet time. Backup codes were provided at 2FA setup. If lost, support can disable 2FA after identity verification.

input.subject: API returning 500 errors intermittently
input.body: About 10% of our API requests are failing with 500 errors. We have automated workflows that are breaking. This started 2 hours ago.

must_not: dismiss as normal
ask user to retry without explanation

metadata.context: Elevated 500 error rate is confirmed on the status page as of 2 hours ago. Engineering is investigating. Mitigation: implement exponential backoff. ETA for resolution: under investigation.

input.subject: Report generation is very slow
input.body: Generating reports that used to take 10 seconds now takes over 5 minutes. This started about a week ago. I generate reports multiple times a day.

must_cover: ask for report size or type to diagnose
must_not: claim performance is expected
ignore the week-long duration

metadata.context: Report generation slowdown is a known regression introduced 7 days ago affecting reports with >500 rows. Workaround: filter to smaller date ranges. Fix in next release, ETA 3 days.

input.subject: Duplicate charges on account
input.body: I was charged twice for the same subscription this month. I can see two identical transactions on my bank statement from the same day.

must_not: dispute the user's claim before investigating
make them wait more than necessary

metadata.context: Duplicate charges are caused by a known payment retry bug. Both charges can be verified in Stripe. Full refund of duplicate charge issued within 2 business days.

input.subject: Database connection errors in production
input.body: Our production environment is throwing database connection errors. Approximately 30% of requests are failing. We have an SLA breach if this isn't resolved in 2 hours.

must_not: treat as routine
give a generic response without urgency match

metadata.context: Database connection errors at 30% failure rate is a P1 incident. On-call engineer should be paged immediately. Status updates every 15 minutes. SLA breach compensation requires a formal incident report.

input.subject: Attachment preview broken
input.body: Clicking on any attachment in a record no longer shows the preview — it just shows a spinner. Downloading still works. This is affecting all file types.

must_not: claim previews are unsupported
ask user to clear cache without basis

metadata.context: Attachment preview is broken since yesterday's CDN config change. Download functionality is unaffected. Fix is in review, ETA 24 hours. Ticket logged as BUG-4421.

input.subject: SSO not working for new users
input.body: New users joining our organisation through SSO get a 'User not provisioned' error. Existing users are fine. We have 15 people who can't start onboarding.

must_cover: identify SCIM provisioning as likely cause
must_not: ask all 15 users to contact support individually
ignore the scale of the problem

metadata.context: New user SSO failures usually mean SCIM provisioning is not set up or the SCIM token has expired. Fix: re-generate SCIM token in Admin > SSO > SCIM. Manual workaround: invite users directly via email while SSO is fixed.

input.subject: How to revoke an API key?
input.body: One of our developers left the company and I need to revoke their API key immediately to prevent unauthorized access. I can see the key in settings but can't find a revoke button.

must_cover: exact steps to revoke the key
must_not: downplay the security urgency
give vague steps

metadata.context: API keys can be revoked at Settings > API Keys > click the key > Revoke. Revocation is immediate. After revoking, audit remaining keys and rotate any shared keys as a precaution.

input.subject: Emails sent from platform going to spam
input.body: Automated emails sent from your platform are landing in our customers' spam folders. We're using the shared sending domain. Can we set up a custom sending domain?

must_cover: steps to set up or who to contact
must_not: claim spam is not their problem
give SPF/DKIM steps that don't apply to their setup

metadata.context: Custom sending domain is available on Business and Enterprise plans. Setup: Admin > Email > Custom Domain, add DNS records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC). Interim: add shared sending domain to your SPF record.

input.subject: Mobile app keeps crashing on launch
input.body: After the latest update the iOS app crashes immediately on startup. I've reinstalled three times and it still crashes. I cannot use the product at all on mobile.

must_cover: iOS version or device details needed
must_not: ask user to reinstall again
imply crash is user's fault

metadata.context: iOS crash on launch is a known bug introduced in v3.4.1 affecting iOS 16 and below. Fix submitted to App Store, pending review (ETA 2-3 days). Workaround: use the web app at app.example.com.

input.subject: Wrong amount charged on annual renewal
input.body: My annual renewal charged $240 but the agreed price was $199 based on the quote I accepted. Please correct this and refund the difference.

must_cover: refund of the difference once confirmed
must_not: dispute the user's memory without checking
ask user to repay or accept the higher price

metadata.context: Pricing discrepancies can occur when a quote's locked price expires before renewal. Verify the original quote in the billing system. If confirmed, refund the $41 difference within 2 business days.

input.subject: Charts not rendering in PDF export
input.body: When I export a report to PDF, all the charts show as blank white boxes. The data tables export fine. This started happening after last Friday's update.

must_not: ask user to re-export without suggesting anything new
deny the regression

metadata.context: PDF chart rendering broke in Friday's release due to a Puppeteer version change. Data tables are unaffected. Workaround: export to CSV for data, screenshot charts manually. Fix ETA: 2 days.

input.subject: Emergency: all users getting 403 on login
input.body: Starting 10 minutes ago, every user in our organisation is getting a 403 Forbidden error when trying to log in. We are completely locked out. This is a critical emergency.

must_not: ask standard troubleshooting questions
give a standard response time

metadata.context: Organisation-wide 403 on login is typically caused by an expired SSO certificate or a misconfigured IP allowlist. P1 response: page on-call, give status update within 15 minutes.

input.subject: Forgot password link not working
input.body: I clicked 'Forgot Password' but the reset email never arrived. I checked spam. I've tried three times over the past two hours.

must_not: tell user to try the same thing a 4th time
ignore the 2-hour duration

metadata.context: Password reset emails are sent from noreply@example.com. If not received after 2 hours, the email address may be wrong or the account may be using SSO. Support can trigger a manual reset or confirm the account email.

input.subject: Search results returning wrong data
input.body: When I search for records by date range, the results include records outside the range I specified. This is producing incorrect reports.

must_cover: ask for specific date range to reproduce
confirm whether a fix is planned
must_not: dismiss as user error without investigation
ignore the report accuracy impact

metadata.context: Date range search bug is confirmed: records with timestamps in UTC are compared against user-local dates without timezone conversion. Fix in progress, ETA 1 week. Workaround: add 1 day to end date.

input.subject: How to set up webhooks?
input.body: I'm trying to configure a webhook to notify our system when a new record is created. The documentation shows a Webhooks section but I can't find it in my account.

must_cover: check plan tier for webhooks availability
alternative if not on the right plan
must_not: point to docs that don't match their account
ignore that they can't find the feature

metadata.context: Webhooks are available on Business plan and above. Location: Settings > Integrations > Webhooks. If not visible, the account is on a Starter plan. Upgrade path: Account > Plan > Upgrade.

input.subject: Data export is missing some records
input.body: I exported all records for Q3 but comparing to the UI count there are 47 records missing from the export file. The UI shows 1,203 but the CSV only has 1,156.

must_cover: explain export row limit if applicable
how to get the remaining records
must_not: dismiss the discrepancy
tell user the numbers are probably right

metadata.context: CSV export is capped at 1,156 rows (a known undocumented limit). The remaining 47 records can be retrieved by exporting with a narrower date range. Fix to raise the cap is planned.

input.subject: Change account owner to new employee
input.body: Our previous account owner left the company. I need to transfer ownership to myself. I have admin access but can't find the ownership transfer option.

must_not: require the departed employee to initiate
ask for information the user already provided (admin access)

metadata.context: Account ownership transfer requires: existing admin role (confirmed), submit request via Settings > Account > Transfer Ownership, identity verification by support team. Completed within 1 business day.

input.subject: Notifications not working on iOS
input.body: Push notifications stopped arriving on my iPhone about 5 days ago. Android works fine. I've checked all permissions and notifications are enabled.

must_cover: check iOS version or recent update correlation
must_not: repeat permission checks user already did
claim Android working means iOS should too

metadata.context: iOS push notifications are broken on devices running iOS 17.4+ since an APNS certificate was not renewed. Fix submitted, ETA 3 days. Workaround: enable email notifications as a fallback.

input.subject: Service completely down for 200 users
input.body: The entire platform is showing 503 errors. We have 200 users who can't work. This is causing major business disruption. Please respond immediately.

must_not: give a template response that ignores scale
cite a 24-hour SLA response time

metadata.context: Platform-wide 503 is a P1 incident. Status: status.example.com. On-call team is engaged. Update cadence: every 15 minutes until resolved.

input.subject: Tax exemption for non-profit subscription
input.body: We are a non-profit and are exempt from sales tax. How do I submit our tax exemption certificate so future invoices don't include tax?

must_cover: which invoices will be affected retroactively if any
must_not: ask user to email a generic address without a process
promise retroactive refunds without policy basis

metadata.context: Tax exemption certificates are submitted via Account > Billing > Tax Exemption > Upload Certificate. Processing takes 2-3 business days. Exemption applies to future invoices only; retroactive refunds are not standard but can be requested.
